cues.text: A delivery order has to reach the right door with nobody there to check it. So we check it twice before it leaves.
One. The order is complete. Every piece is there and checked.
Two. It is paid, or there is a card on file. Unpaid deliveries show up in the To Be Done list.
Three. Check the address and the apartment number on the ticket. The apartment number prints big for a reason.
Four. Bag it, and put the ticket with the name and apartment on the outside of every bag.
Five. Scan every bag in the Delivery screen, so it goes on the driver’s route.
Six. The driver takes a photo when it is dropped off, as proof of delivery.
A good delivery bag has the name and a big, clear apartment number on the outside. Folded items get their own labeled bag.
In the van, hang long pieces instead of folding them, group bags by building, and never leave clothes on the floor.
